When the current access token expires. W: When the current access token expires. With a refresh token, Bifrost renews it on the next request, so an active row past its expiry silently mints a new token at use time. Without one, a past expiry means the row must be re-authenticated. Header rows do not have an upstream expiry; their values stay valid until revoked or the schema changes.

When this grant last refreshed its acces: When this grant last refreshed its access token. MCP clients refresh as their token nears expiry, so this tracks the grant's most recent activity. Grants that have not refreshed since they were authorized fall back to when they were created.
